body_text:
Quantifier negation obeys the dualities
$\neg\forall x\in D\,P(x)\iff\exists x\in D\,\neg P(x)$ and
$\neg\exists x\in D\,P(x)\iff\forall x\in D\,\neg P(x)$. Thus the
negation of a universal claim asks for a counterexample, while the
negation of an existential claim excludes every possible witness.
